text: I've waited three weeks to do something. All right. I'll suspend her access and keep her in the lab until the police can talk to her.
style: Chief Security Officer, early fifties, ex-military. Speak with a consistent South Wales (Cardiff) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Firm, low-to-mid pitch; brisk, economical pace. Direct, dry and steady under pressure; her warmth shows only in what she chooses to notice.
